text: ok I've been waiting ages for a callback that never came so writing instead. Looking after my nephew, he's 5 months. He's teething I think, dribbling everywhere, gnawing on anything he can grab and one cheek's gone bright red. He was sick once about 7ish but he's had his bottle since and some water and kept it all down no problem. Also, and I'm probably overthinking this, his lips looked blue earlier and gave me a fright, but my daughter had given him a lick of her blue raspberry ice lolly when I wasn't looking 🙄 I wiped his mouth and the blue came off on the wipe and his lips are pink underneath, so I think it's just the dye. Not sure if there's anything I should be doing for the teething at that age or if I just leave him be?
